###############################################################################
# Power Without War: core per-resource effects (GENERATED, one block per resource)
#
# Generated by the core lane from one template; the seven blocks are identical
# except for the resource token and the oil/coal extra terms. Edit all seven
# together (or regenerate) when tuning.
#
# Public effects (country scope):
#   pww_core_resolve_country_map = yes
#       Rebuilds this country's map arrays from its OWNED states:
#         pww_producing_states_<res>  states with raw resource <res> > 0
#         pww_coastal_states          coastal owned states
#       Also sets pww_map_owned_states (owned state count at resolve time) and
#       clears country flag pww_map_dirty.
#   pww_core_update_desperation = yes
#       Recomputes pww_desp_<res> (0..100, integer) for all seven resources,
#       plus pww_desp_max (highest) and pww_desp_max_res (its resource index).
#       Helper state kept per resource: pww_deficit_streak_<res> (consecutive
#       ticks in deficit, 0..6).
#
# Desperation model (per resource, per staggered tick, roughly every 30 days):
#   need      = resource_consumed@res - min(resource@res, 0)  (demand: met use
#               plus the open shortfall; resource_consumed is met use only)
#   shortfall = clamp(-resource@res / need, 0, 1)       (resource@ is net surplus)
#   streak    = +1 if shortfall > 0.05 else reset to 0  (capped at 6)
#   duration  = 0 if streak < 2, 0.6 if streak = 2, 1.0 if streak >= 3
#               (short or lumpy deficits are filtered out)
#   raw       = 70 * shortfall * duration
#             + 20 * clamp(resource_imported@res / need, 0, 1)   (import exposure)
#   oil only:  + 60 * max(0, 0.5 - fuel_ratio)    when max_fuel_k > 1
#   coal only: + 80 * max(0, 1 - energy_ratio)    when energy_ratio > 0.01
#   war:       raw = raw * 1.25 + 10              when has_war and raw > 0
#   raw clamped 0..100; stored value = round(0.4 * previous + 0.6 * raw)
#   Test hook: country var pww_desp_floor_<res> (unset = none) floors the
#   stored value (integration tests force a desperate claimant).
# All constants are first-pass placeholders for playtest tuning.
###############################################################################

pww_core_resolve_country_map = {
	clear_array = pww_coastal_states
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_oil
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_aluminium
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_rubber
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_tungsten
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_steel
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_chromium
	clear_array = pww_producing_states_coal
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_coastal = yes }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_coastal_states = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = oil amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_oil = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = aluminium amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_aluminium = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = rubber amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_rubber = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = tungsten amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_tungsten = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = steel amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_steel = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = chromium amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_chromium = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_resources_amount = { resource = coal amount > 0 } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.pww_producing_states_coal = THIS }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { pww_map_owned_states = num_owned_states }
	set_variable = { pww_map_resolved_day = global.num_days }
	clr_country_flag = pww_map_dirty
}

pww_core_update_desperation = {
	set_variable = { pww_desp_max = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_desp_max_res = -1 }

	### oil (index 0)
	# Demand = met use plus the open shortfall (resource_consumed is met use).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_need = resource@oil }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_need min = -99999 max = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_need = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_need = resource_consumed@oil }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_short = resource@oil }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_short = -1 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_short value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_short min = 0 max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_short > 0.05 } }
		add_to_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_oil = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = pww_deficit_streak_oil min = 0 max = 6 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_oil = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_oil > 2.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_oil > 1.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0.6 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_short }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 70 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_dur }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_imp = resource_imported@oil }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp min = 0 max = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_imp = 20 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_imp }
	# Fuel runway: low stored fuel raises oil desperation.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { max_fuel_k > 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_extra = fuel_ratio }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_extra = -1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_extra = 0.5 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_extra min = 0 max = 0.5 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_extra = 60 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_extra }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			check_variable = { pww_raw > 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 1.25 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 10 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 0.6 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_prev = pww_desp_oil }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_prev = 0.4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_prev }
	round_temp_variable = pww_raw
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_floor_oil > pww_raw } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_desp_floor_oil }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_desp_oil = pww_raw }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_oil > pww_desp_max } }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max = pww_desp_oil }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max_res = 0 }
	}

	### aluminium (index 1)
	# Demand = met use plus the open shortfall (resource_consumed is met use).
	set_temp_variable = { pww_need = resource@aluminium }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_need min = -99999 max = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_need = -1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_need = resource_consumed@aluminium }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_short = resource@aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_short = -1 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_short value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_short min = 0 max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_short > 0.05 } }
		add_to_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_aluminium = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = pww_deficit_streak_aluminium min = 0 max = 6 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_aluminium = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_aluminium > 2.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_aluminium > 1.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0.6 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_short }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 70 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_dur }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_imp = resource_imported@aluminium }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp min = 0 max = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_imp = 20 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_imp }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			check_variable = { pww_raw > 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 1.25 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 10 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 0.6 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_prev = pww_desp_aluminium }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_prev = 0.4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_prev }
	round_temp_variable = pww_raw
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_floor_aluminium > pww_raw } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_desp_floor_aluminium }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_desp_aluminium = pww_raw }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_aluminium > pww_desp_max } }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max = pww_desp_aluminium }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max_res = 1 }
	}

	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_short = -1 }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_short value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_short min = 0 max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_short > 0.05 } }
		add_to_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_coal = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = pww_deficit_streak_coal min = 0 max = 6 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_coal = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_coal > 2.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_deficit_streak_coal > 1.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_dur = 0.6 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_short }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 70 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_dur }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_imp = resource_imported@coal }
	divide_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp value = pww_need if_zero = 0 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_imp min = 0 max = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_imp = 20 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_imp }
	# Energy shortfall: coal desperation reads energy_ratio.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { energy_ratio > 0.01 } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_extra = energy_ratio }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_extra = -1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_extra = 1 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_extra min = 0 max = 1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_extra = 80 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_extra }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			check_variable = { pww_raw > 0 }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 1.25 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 10 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_raw = 0.6 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_prev = pww_desp_coal }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_prev = 0.4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_prev }
	round_temp_variable = pww_raw
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = pww_raw min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_floor_coal > pww_raw } }
		set_temp_variable = { pww_raw = pww_desp_floor_coal }
	}
	set_variable = { pww_desp_coal = pww_raw }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_coal > pww_desp_max } }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max = pww_desp_coal }
		set_variable = { pww_desp_max_res = 6 }
	}

	set_variable = { pww_desp_updated_day = global.num_days }
}

# Debug: logs this country's core state to game.log. Called by the core
# tick only when global flag pww_core_debug is set.
pww_core_debug_log_country = {
	log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CORE tick [This.GetTag] bucket=[?pww_bucket] desp_max=[?pww_desp_max] desp_max_res=[?pww_desp_max_res]"
	log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CORE desp [This.GetTag] oil=[?pww_desp_oil] aluminium=[?pww_desp_aluminium] rubber=[?pww_desp_rubber] tungsten=[?pww_desp_tungsten] steel=[?pww_desp_steel] chromium=[?pww_desp_chromium] coal=[?pww_desp_coal]"
	log = "[GetDateText] PWW_CORE map [This.GetTag] coastal=[?pww_coastal_states^num] oil=[?pww_producing_states_oil^num] aluminium=[?pww_producing_states_aluminium^num] rubber=[?pww_producing_states_rubber^num] tungsten=[?pww_producing_states_tungsten^num] steel=[?pww_producing_states_steel^num] chromium=[?pww_producing_states_chromium^num] coal=[?pww_producing_states_coal^num]"
}
